notes: DHIS2 is an open-source health information platform whose core server generates its own OpenAPI 3.0 document at /api/openapi/openapi.json. This is that document, captured verbatim from the DHIS2 project's own public play instance running stable 2.43.1 (/api/system/info reports version 2.43.1, revision 9cbfbf3; info.version inside the spec still reads 2.42, which is DHIS2's own labelling and is left untouched). 1779 paths / 2574 operations / 925 schemas, replacing a 20 KiB hand-made test fixture that covered a token slice of the API. Full coverage matters more here than for most adaptors: @openfn/language-dhis2 exposes only generic CRUD builders (create, get, update, upsert, destroy) over an arbitrary resource path, so a job can reach any endpoint in this file. servers[0].url points at the demo host because DHIS2 is self-hosted and has no single production base URL - the adaptor takes the host from state.configuration.hostUrl and prefixes /api (optionally /api/{apiVersion}). Two upstream quirks are preserved as-is: path keys carry a #operationName fragment where DHIS2 disambiguates several operations on one path, and the legacy /api/events and /api/trackedEntityInstances endpoints are absent because 2.41+ replaced them with /api/tracker/*. The spec endpoint is only served to a logged-in client, so re-checking drift needs the public demo login documented at https://dhis2.org/demo; the contentHash will also move whenever the play instance is rebuilt on a newer patch.
